courseProjects.title: Library Book Tracker
courseProjects.description: A library management system with built-in fuzzy matching for intelligent book search and discovery. Allows users to track their reading, manage book collections, and find similar titles even with typos or partial queries.
features: Fuzzy string matching for intelligent search

research.title: Food Insecurity in Pakistan
research.abstract: An exploration of the systemic factors contributing to food insecurity across Pakistan, examining economic, environmental, and policy dimensions that affect food access and distribution.

research.title: AI and Its Impact on Marginalized Groups
research.abstract: A critical examination of how artificial intelligence systems affect marginalized communities, exploring bias in algorithms, accessibility challenges, and the ethical implications of AI deployment.
